parameters.name: searchStr
parameters.description: Searches profiles by name or description. Note: The string must contain at least one character. Supported search methods are: exact match (string), starts-with (string%), and contains (%string%).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the profiles must be listed

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of profiles to list. The default value is 250 and the maximum value allowed is 250

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of optional fields to include in the response. Allowed values: type, isVisible, default, modifiedBy, modifiedTime, permissions, description
